title: Syndication deals
description: Publicly announced agreements between outlets and Chinese state media (pipeline/syndication.py). Each entry names a monitored outlet by outlet_id, or an outlet the tracker does not monitor with unmonitored: true and outlet_name, and needs a public https source that states the deal and its date.

unmonitored.description: true for an outlet the tracker does not monitor; outlet_name then names it

partner.description: other: provincial or municipal Chinese state media, or another central body such as Economic Daily, named in the notes

signed_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY, matching precision

confidence.description: stated: a party to the deal announced it; reported: a third party reported it

verification.description: The re-check of the source: whether the page at source_url (or, for source_moved, the page now cited) states the deal and the date it gives. A check of sources, not a hand check of the measure.

status.description: verified: the page states the parties, the kind and the date; source_moved: the original page no longer serves it and source_url now names a page that does (previous_url keeps the old one); unverified: no page could be read that states it

page_date.description: the signing date the page gives, at the precision it gives

archived_url.description: an archived copy of source_url that was read when the live page refused the crawler
